contracts.statement: A merchant's route decision must be causally driven by a legally obtained observation or belief update about route danger. The routeBeliefs for the bandit's road must have been raised by the observation (source === 'observation'), and the merchant's chosen route must avoid the bandit's road from tick 2 onward when the merchant's perceptionAccuracy is 1 and the bandit's is 0.
contracts.rationale: Constitution §161 EMERGENT CHAIN TEST 4 (BANDIT ADAPTATION) and Guardian V3 §3 require the cat-and-mouse dynamic to be information-driven, not ground-truth-driven. The merchant must react to the bandit's presence via a legal observation channel, not by reading the bandit's authoritative hidden location directly.

source.constitutionalAnchor: Constitution §161 emergent chain TEST 4; Guardian V3 §3 Movement G

preconditions: merchant has at least two eligible routes
merchant.perceptionAccuracy === 1
bandit.perceptionAccuracy === 0
forbidden: merchant reads bandit.roadId directly in chooseMerchantRouteDecision
merchant route change without a corresponding routeBelief update whose source is 'observation'

contracts.statement: The one-shot closed-world scenario must emit the causal sequence: CONVOY_FORMED, BANDIT_ATTACK, RUMOR, ROUTE_SELECTED, FACTION_REASSESSMENT, FACTION_ACTION, INVASION, BANDIT_RELOCATION — in that order. Membership (toContain) is not sufficient; the order encodes the causal narrative (attack → rumor → route → reassess → action → invasion → relocation).
contracts.rationale: Constitution §53/§161 require the causal chain to be traceable. A reordered event stream breaks causal provenance. Guardian V3 §1 item #2 explicitly named the weakening from toEqual to toContain.

source.constitutionalAnchor: Constitution §53 causal trace; Guardian V3 §1 item #2

preconditions: runClosedWorldScenario called with world where bandit.lootExpectation === 0.95 and bandit.switchMargin === 0
perceivedDanger: 0.8
forbidden: test asserts membership (toContain) instead of ordered sequence (toEqual)
test mutates world after runClosedWorldScenario and accepts 'bandit may stay'
contracts.observableConsequence: eventTypes in result.events are exactly [CONVOY_FORMED, BANDIT_ATTACK, RUMOR, ROUTE_SELECTED, FACTION_REASSESSMENT, FACTION_ACTION, INVASION, BANDIT_RELOCATION] in that order
contracts.requiredEvidenceType: ordered sequence assertion + planted-defect (delete BANDIT_RELOCATION from one-shot → test fails)

contracts.statement: Simulation.runClosedWorldStep must invoke the canonical reducer (tickClosedWorld) exactly once per step. The production runtime path IS the canonical path; no test-only manual bridge is allowed.
contracts.rationale: Guardian V3 §4 Movement C §C2: 'Prove there is exactly one authoritative simulation advancement path per intended tick. Detect: double ticking, helper + reducer duplicate execution, stale wrappers, test-only entry paths.' V4 MOVEMENT C2 (2026-10-18) formalizes the at-least-once half as the exact-once tick phase: the canonical call site must exist and run in production, and it must be the only one.

contracts.statement: Exact-once tick phase (V4 MOVEMENT C2): every intended tick advances the canonical reducer at most once. No test or production path may call tickClosedWorld more than once per intended tick, and every MERCHANT_ROUTE_DECISION in tick T belongs to a distinct merchant unless an explicit replan event authorizes another decision. Tests that manually call tickClosedWorld after Simulation.runClosedWorldStep are a P0 architecture defect.
contracts.rationale: Guardian V3 §4 Movement C §C2: 'Detect: double ticking, helper + reducer duplicate execution, stale wrappers.' The V3 planted defect was the step-7.5 second merchant canonical tick (EVID-2026-08-29-CANONICAL-TRADE-INTEGRATION); MUT-RUNTIME-001 re-plants it in real source and the probe must kill it.

contracts.statement: A 'no attacks' scenario must produce 0 BANDIT_ATTACK events through natural causal conditions, not through a noObservations fixture switch. The noObservations flag is a TEST_FIXTURE_ONLY mechanism and must never be the only path to 0 attacks.
contracts.rationale: Guardian V3 §2 Movement A §A2: 'A test fixture may force a precondition only when the contract is conditional on that precondition. Not allowed: forcing hidden variables until the desired event occurred.' Guardian V3 §1 item #6: 'a noObservations fixture mode was introduced to obtain a zero-attack scenario.'
preconditions: no bandit on any route where a merchant has selectedRoute
mechanism: bandit stays on a road with no merchant traffic
encounter engine finds no eligible bandit-ambush
forbidden: test forces perceptionAccuracy to 0 to achieve 0 attacks
noObservations flag is the only path to 0 attacks
contracts.observableConsequence: When the bandit is on a road with no merchant AND the merchant's selectedRoute is a different road, the encounter engine must not fire bandit-ambush and BANDIT_ATTACK must not appear in the event log, without any fixture switch.
contracts.requiredEvidenceType: natural scenario test (no fixture switch) + planted-defect (make merchant pick bandit's road naturally → attacks appear)

contracts.statement: Different scenario inputs (calm vs nervous, no-attacks vs sustained-attacks) must produce observably different world states. The differentiation must be causally driven, not coincidental.
contracts.rationale: World-Completion Directive §19: 'Scenario differentiation is mandatory. Every significant decision system must prove that meaningful inputs matter.'
preconditions: two matched scenarios with single-input difference
forbidden: test asserts 'either A or B differs' (a non-contract)
differentiation is coincidental rather than causally driven
contracts.observableConsequence: calm vs nervous must produce at least one metric with a consistent sign-of-difference (e.g., sustainedAttacks → migrationCount >= noAttacks migrationCount)
contracts.requiredEvidenceType: directional comparison + planted-defect (force sustainedAttacks to no-op → differentiation disappears)

contracts.statement: The merchant may only learn about the bandit's location through a legal observation channel (perceptionAccuracy on the merchant, observation event with proper provenance). The merchant must never read bandit.roadId directly in chooseMerchantRouteDecision.
contracts.rationale: Guardian V3 §3: 'actors can be wrong' — the cat-and-mouse is genuinely partial-observable. Direct ground-truth reads are the forbidden shortcut the V3 auditor must catch.
preconditions: merchant.perceptionAccuracy is set
bandit is on a known road
mechanism: bandit presence → observation event → routeBelief update → route decision
forbidden: chooseMerchantRouteDecision reads bandit.roadId
routeBelief source is 'ground_truth' or undefined
contracts.observableConsequence: routeBelief source for the bandit's road is 'observation' (not 'ground_truth') when the merchant's perceptionAccuracy triggered the update
contracts.requiredEvidenceType: planted-defect (replace observation wire with bandit.roadId read → test still passes, contract violated → mark as IMPLEMENTATION_FIX_REQUIRED)

contracts.statement: Repeated execution of the same evidence seed with the same inputs must produce exactly one active row in the ledger. Idempotency is keyed on (claimId, dimension, source-state fingerprint) and holds under concurrency: the read-check-append critical section is serialized under an exclusive ledger lock.
contracts.rationale: Guardian V3 §5 Movement D §D1 item 4: 'repeated seed script execution → no duplicate active proof.' V4 MOVEMENT E2 closed the concurrent race: the pre-E2 read-check-append was non-atomic, so two simultaneous seeds could both pass the duplicate check.

preconditions: ledger file exists and is parseable

contracts.observableConsequence: running the same seed twice produces exactly one row; K concurrent same-claim seeds produce exactly one row and leave no lock remnant; running it with a changed fingerprint produces two rows (old becomes stale, new is fresh)
contracts.requiredEvidenceType: idempotency probe (1) same inputs → one row, (2) K concurrent same-claim seeds → exactly one row + no lock remnant, (3) different fingerprint → two rows; real-source mutation MUT-EVID-001 killed by this probe (receipt docs/guardian/mutation-receipts/MUT-EVID-001-1792292235781.json)

contracts.statement: A seed script may gather proof but may not decide maturity. Maturity is derived from claim-specific admissible evidence. A maturity label is NOT valid merely because a seed script found a symbol, a test filename, a green exit code, or a matching string.
contracts.rationale: Guardian V3 §5 Movement D §D5: 'Evidence producer is not evidence authority.'
preconditions: evidence row with a dimension
linter run
forbidden: linter labels a domain CROSS_DOMAIN_INTEGRATED merely because 7 seed-script rows exist
seed script decides maturity
contracts.observableConsequence: A row with dimension CROSS_DOMAIN_INTEGRATED only contributes to the label if it has a real command receipt, a real source-state fingerprint, and no known contradictions.
contracts.requiredEvidenceType: linter test (1) row with no command → not admissible, (2) row with contradiction → label capped

contracts.statement: Migration pressure must be driven by recent BANDIT_ATTACK events (within a 5-tick window). In a peaceful world with no recent attacks, the JusticeSystem's migration pressure must drop below 0.5 and no MIGRATION events must fire. A periodic MIGRATION from baseline JusticeSystem values is a P0 defect.
contracts.rationale: Guardian V3 §8 Movement F §F1: 'No invisible duplication. No disappearing cargo.' Guardian V3 §1 item 3: migration fired on a fixed timer with no push factor.
preconditions: JusticeSystem.resolve() called per tick
BANDIT_ATTACK events may or may not have occurred recently
mechanism: BANDIT_ATTACK → reportedCrime (5-tick window) → grievance accumulation → migration pressure
forbidden: JusticeSystem.resolve() produces migration pressure > 0.5 from baseline values when reportedCrime is false
reportedCrime is sticky once any attack ever happened
contracts.observableConsequence: low-pressure world produces 0 MIGRATION events; high-pressure world (recent BANDIT_ATTACK within 5 ticks) produces > 0 MIGRATION events
contracts.requiredEvidenceType: directional comparison (low vs high pressure) + planted-defect (remove the 5-tick window → low-pressure fires migrations)

contracts.statement: The runtime must boot and keep ticking in a real browser from the built artifact: a Vite build of the current source, served on loopback and loaded by a real headless Chrome, must produce a populated simulation and DOM counters (#pop-count, #gen-count, #avg-fear) that advance across observation windows. Proven only under a DOM shim (jsdom), frozen after a single frame, or read from a stale dist the probe did not build all fail this contract.
contracts.rationale: Guardian MOVEMENT D2: 'runtime uses DOM shim, not real browser.' The retired Jest suites instantiated the simulation under jsdom and nothing since proved the runtime in a real browser; evidence/seed-runtime-verification.mjs recorded that limitation explicitly. This contract closes the boot-and-tick half at DOM level; it makes no rendering or visual-fidelity claim.
